BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring copayments for cough medicine forrecipients of medical assistance and medical care services; and addinga new section to chapter 74.09 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A recipient of medical assistance under RCW 74.09.510 or medicalcare services under RCW 74.09.035 must pay a copayment in the amount ofone dollar for each filled prescription for an overthecounter coughsyrup containing guaifenesin or dextromethorphan or a combination ofguaifenesin and dextromethorphan.
